fields.label: Start value
fields.help: Signed 64-bit integer. Creation defaults to 1, including negative increments. For an existing sequence, CREATE OR ALTER restarts the next value; the stored initial value is unchanged.

fields.label: Increment by
fields.help: Nonzero integer from -2147483647 to 2147483647. Creation defaults to 1.
